## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, type-check, content validation, tests, build)
- [ ] No runtime requests to third parties; no audio or text leaves the browser
- [ ] UI text goes through `t()` and exists in every locale (`en.ts` and `pt-BR.ts`)
- [ ] New content is original or public domain (no lyrics) and released under CC0
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes (desktop and mobile)
- [ ] Tested in: <!-- e.g. Chrome 130, Firefox 131, Safari iOS 18 — see docs/BROWSER_TESTING.md -->
